Who We Are

A Pharmacist-Founded House of Medicine

Sharex Laboratories was established in 1962 by two young, energetic pharmacists who pooled a modest capital of one hundred thousand rupees around one clear objective: manufacture and market the medicines people commonly need — at moderate prices, with excellent quality.

Steady, intensive effort turned that small beginning into a prominent position in Pakistan's pharmaceutical industry. Today our authorised capital stands at Rs. 20 million, and Sharex ranks 15th among Pakistan's pharmaceutical manufacturers in investment and sales, excluding multinational joint ventures.

From our plant at Sharex Colony, Sadiqabad, our products reach patients across the country through a nationwide distribution network — while close contact with leading research companies worldwide keeps our range moving with modern medicine.

✓
GMP manufacturing under the Pakistan Drug Rules 1976, verified at every stage.
✓
Five production lines — injectables, tablets, medicinal syrups, ophthalmics and galenicals.
✓
Patented drug-delivery technologies for controlled rate and duration of release.

What We Do

Our Technology Platforms

Sharex at a glance: highly versatile, patented drug-delivery technologies — engineered for controlled duration, controlled rate and complete bioerosion.

Parenteral Delivery

Injectable and implantable systems built on bioerodible polymers, giving clinicians precise control over how a medicine is released inside the body.

  • Controlled duration of drug delivery
  • Controlled rate of drug delivery
  • Complete bioerosion — nothing left behind
  • Simple, flexible fabrication

Oral Delivery

Sustained and site-specific oral formulations — tablets, capsules and liquids designed to deliver the right dose, at the right place, for the right length of time.

  • Reliable sustained delivery
  • Site-specific release
  • Tablets, capsules, syrups & suspensions

Topical Delivery

Creams, liniments and antiseptic preparations adaptable to a wide variety of substances — approved products trusted on skin across Pakistan.

  • Approved, proven products
  • Adaptable to diverse substances
  • Creams, liniments & solutions

Quality & Compliance

Checked at Every Stage. Trusted at Every Step.

For Sharex, quality is not a department — it is a system that follows every batch from raw material to final pack.

1

Multistage Quality Control

Our QC department runs a close-examination system across three checkpoints — incoming raw material, in-process production, and final packaging.

2

GMP Manufacturing

Production follows the Good Manufacturing Practice provisions laid down under the Pakistan Drug Rules 1976, in a plant equipped with modern machinery.

3

Licensed & Registered

Drug Manufacturing Licence No. 000079 (Formulation), DRAP Pakistan — with a registered range marketed nationwide.

Life With Us

The Sharex Family

A company is known by how it treats its own. For over six decades, our people have been our strength — and we look after them like family.
